items.name: OpenAI GPT-6 with Intelligent UI
items.summary: OpenAI began the global rollout of GPT-6 in ChatGPT on Oct 7, adding an Intelligent UI that renders interactive elements — charts, forms, calculators, games — inside responses instead of plain text. Paid tiers get GPT-6 Sol while Free and Go users get GPT-6 Luna, with free-tier access starting Oct 8.

items.name: Anthropic Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 on Oct 7, closing out the Claude 5.5 family with a 1M-token context window and aggressive pricing at $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens — a tenth of Haiku 4.5 and exactly matching OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna. It posts major agent-benchmark gains, including 72.4% on OSWorld 2.1.

items.name: Illumina SpliceAI2
items.summary: Illumina launched SpliceAI2 on Oct 8, a genomic AI model from its BioInsight AI Lab that predicts how genetic variants alter RNA splicing, trained on 100x more data than its 2019 predecessor. It identified 17% more disease-relevant variants than other splicing models and joins PromoterAI and PrimateAI-3D in its genomic model suite.
